observatories_and_archives.facility: Telescopio Nazionale Galileo (TNG 3.58 m), Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, La Palma
Calar Alto Observatory (3.50 m), Almeria, Spain
observatories_and_archives.dichroic_note: Beam splitter (~960 nm) feeds NIR channel; VIS SNR drops steeply >995 nm (FOX SNR 0.5-1.2 at >=1027 nm).
observatories_and_archives.data_products: CARACAL DR1 multi-HDU FITS (SPEC, CONT, SIG, WAVE)

external_catalogs: ESA Gaia DR3 lite (dc.g-vo.org gaia.dr3lite): parallaxes, distances (<10 pc census), proper motions, G/BP/RP photometry
2MASS Point Source Catalog (dc.g-vo.org twomass.data): J/H/Ks photometry via J2000 PM-propagated cone match
NASA Exoplanet Archive (exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu ps / pscomppars): zero-planet control verification & orbital ephemerides (T0, P_orb, e, M_*)
NIST Atomic Spectra Database: 12 HARPS-N and 12 CARMENES_VIS vacuum photospheric RV anchors
